items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: I made this tour with him in Pennsylvania, in South Bend, Indiana, for a couple of weeks.

ctx.x: But it was I know him at Twyre. Very fine reader. And Jimmy Noon, he came down. He heard his name and said, what? And he went back. When he got back to Chicago, he told Joe, he said, man, Albin, they've got a band. You should hit them, kids. So that's when Joe sent for us, you know. To come. And he sent for me first. I made this tour with him in Pennsylvania, in South Bend, Indiana, for a couple of weeks. Then I came back to New Orleans and got with the band again. Then he decided to send for us for. Oh, I see.
